title: Sanctuary by the Sea 2122 Home | KEY.co
description_expanded: Situated on an expansive 23-acre property, this Gulf-front gem offers an unparalleled sense of seclusion and serenity. With 650 feet of sugar sand coastline reserved exclusively for your enjoyment, you can unwind and bask in the sun at your leisure. Whether you're lounging on the beach, taking a refreshing swim in the crystal-clear waters, or simply immersing yourself in the peaceful ambiance, this vacation home promises an unforgettable experience. Welcome to your dream vacation home nestled in the stunning Santa Rosa Beach. This gorgeously decorated oasis exudes streamlined coastal elegance, offering a tranquil escape from the bustling world. With its prime location just steps away from a pristine white sand beach and an adjacent coastal dune lake, you'll wake up each morning to breathtaking sunrises on your expansive private balcony. Indulge in the ultimate relaxation as you soak up the sun in the sparkling pools or unwind in the inviting hot tubs. This retreat provides a haven for leisure and rejuvenation, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the beauty of your surroundings. Immerse yourself in the natural wonders of Scenic Highway 30A, effortlessly exploring the captivating landscapes on foot or by bike.

Features: Backyard Shared gas grill Shared pool Shared hot tub
Parking information- Covered parking. - No boats
Microwave TV Washer Large living room
